newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods segment profits up in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods segment profits up in Q3.

text.p: Dean Foods Co said Thursday each of its business segments posted improved earnings in the third quarter compared with a year ago.
Earlier, it reported quarterly earnings of $0.51 a share, which beat the First Call mean of analysts' estimates of $0.44 a share. A year ago, it earned $0.17 a share.

"The dairy segment reported a significant increase in operating earnings on a solid volume increase and increased operating efficiencies in several of its plants, especially its extended shelf life operations," Howard Dean, chairman, said in a statement.
The dairy segment also benefited from changes in raw milk costs in the third quarter of 1997, compared to a negative impact a year ago, he added.
Dean Foods said dairy segment's quarterly earnings were $27.0 million, up from $13.5 million a year ago, and sales were $443.1 million, up from last year's $409.2 million.

"Our vegetable and pickle businesses both reported strong improvements in operating earnings over the prior year quarter as a result of increased operating efficiencies, more effective procurement, and improved net pricing as a result of better promotional activities management," Dean said.
Vegetable earnings in the quarter were $8.5 million, compared with a year-ago loss of $547,000. Sales declined to $143.4 million from $146.5 million.
"The specialty segment reported another strong quarterly improvement, primarily as a result of higher sales volumes and earnings from our non-dairy creamer products," Dean said.

Specialty earnings in the quarter were $9.0 million on sales of $75.8 million, up from year-ago earnings of $6.2 million on sales of $74.2 million. Pickles earnings rose to $7.8 million from $4.9 million a year ago, although sales declined to $82.6 million from $88.0 million.

"We are extremely pleased with our third quarter results and believe we are well-positioned for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997," Dean said. "Our focus on strategic issues, including acquisitions and cost reduction opportunities, continues."
Dean Foods shares at mid-morning Thursday were up 7/8 at 34-1/8.
